title: PDF, Word, Excel plus malformed, large and partial input: a parse error never looks complete
annotator: claude-sonnet-5.5 worker, hand annotation on 2026-10-24 (human-style reading; no program produced any expected value)
independence_statement: Document contents are described in words, not generated. Expected statuses follow the limitation vocabulary in the parser docs and the rule that a failure must be visible. Oracle status mapping: failed = the parser raised or the boundary rejected the input (for PDF: PdfParseError or a failure before extraction); unsupported = the parser returned output whose only content is an unsupported limitation for the whole input (legacy .doc); partial = the parser returned output with a content-loss limitation (scanned, partial or unsupported part) while other content may remain; complete = the parser returned content with no content-loss limitation. Disclosure-only limitations that every successful parse carries (PDF reading order, word-feature-coverage) do not count as content loss. No parser, fixture builder or A2 code was run or imported. Status words are the oracle vocabulary: complete, partial, unsupported, failed.

sources: docs/notes/parser-pdf.md: SCANNED, image-content partial and empty-page limitations; 'Lifecycle and failures': password-protected input, malformed documents and extraction failures raise PdfParseError; a wrong signature or wrong detected format fails before extraction; the forced output-limit failure; every successful result records disclosure-only reading-order, layout and table limitations

docs/notes/parser-word.md: legacy-doc-unsupported limitation; unsupported-relationships and embedded-object limitations; a successful DOCX parse always includes word-feature-coverage; non-ZIP and malformed packages are rejected
docs/notes/parser-excel.md: ENCRYPTED limitation, metadata-pass failure is partial, non-worksheet sheets unsupported, ZIP member and byte limits fail closed
docs/notes/parser-qualification.md; docs/notes/parser-isolation.md (opaque parser failures, strict rejection of malformed output)
msgloom/preparation/contracts.py: LimitationKind (missing, unsupported, partial, encrypted, scanned)
